changes: NEW ix reinit_rewards_pools (admin-only): closes + re-initializes the 2 PDA reward pool token accounts (weekly_pool at [b"weekly_pool"], monthly_pool at [b"monthly_pool"]) at the SAME PDA addresses bound to the CURRENT config.usdc_mint. Manual 3-step CPI dance per pool: (1) spl_token::close_account (PDA self-signs as authority; transfers lamports to admin), (2) system_instruction::create_account (PDA signs at its own address; admin pays the fresh ~0.002 SOL TokenAccount rent), (3) spl_token::initialize_account3 (mint = config.usdc_mint, owner = self). Anchor's `init` + `close` constraints don't compose cleanly on the same PDA in a single tx; the manual CPI dance bypasses this — SystemProgram::create_account accepts the post-close 0-lamports-SystemProgram-owned state as 'unallocated' and re-allocates at the same address with PDA-signer authorization.

Pre-flight checks per pool (defense in depth): (a) account owner == spl_token::ID, (b) data.len() >= 165, (c) TokenAccount.amount == 0 (PoolNotEmpty defense — admin must drain first if non-zero), (d) TokenAccount.owner == pool's own pubkey (self-authority pattern from initialize_rewards_pools, WrongPoolAuthority defense). 3 unit tests cover the byte-layout assumptions (offsets 0..32 mint, 32..64 owner, 64..72 amount LE u64) + the 165-byte TokenAccount::LEN constant.
